context: Tests whether the agent correctly sets up the working directory outside the project, parses JSONL output to extract the session_id, and persists state to the correct location with the right schema. These are non-obvious implementation details critical to the skill's workflow.

checklist.name: Temp dir outside project
checklist.description: The script creates the working directory outside the project tree (under /tmp or $TMPDIR), not inside the repository

checklist.name: mktemp template
checklist.description: Uses mktemp with a template that falls back through $TMPDIR, then $TEMP, then /tmp (i.e., the pattern ${TMPDIR:-${TEMP:-/tmp}})

checklist.name: codex-review prefix in mktemp
checklist.description: The mktemp template uses 'codex-review-XXXXXX' as the suffix/template name

checklist.name: review-output.md filename
checklist.description: The codex exec review command writes output to a file named review-output.md (not another name)

checklist.name: --json flag used
checklist.description: The codex exec review command includes the --json flag

checklist.name: stderr suppressed
checklist.description: The codex exec review command redirects stderr to /dev/null (2>/dev/null)

checklist.name: JSONL session_meta parsing
checklist.description: The script or documented process parses stdout line-by-line as JSONL and looks for a line where type equals session_meta to extract session_id

checklist.name: state.json location
checklist.description: state.json is written inside the temporary directory (not in the project directory)

checklist.name: state.json schema
checklist.description: state.json contains all four required keys: session_id, iteration, findings, fixed, skipped

checklist.name: Initial iteration value
checklist.description: The initial value of iteration in state.json is 1 (not 0 or any other value)
